user.title: Connect to the De Dietrich cloud
user.description: Use the e-mail address and password of the De Dietrich app (SMART TC°). Only one client should poll the cloud: stop any other tool that uses the same account.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The De Dietrich cloud refused the password of {username}.

error.invalid_auth: E-mail or password refused by the De Dietrich cloud.
error.cannot_connect: The De Dietrich cloud cannot be reached. Try again later.
error.no_appliance: No boiler is linked to this account.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This account gives access to another boiler.

data.max_floor_flow: Maximum allowed flow temperature for the floor

data_description.default_duration: Used when the temperature is changed from Home Assistant.
data_description.connection: Direct: the boiler heating curve sets the water temperature of the floor.
data_description.max_floor_flow: Above it, at the design outdoor temperature, a repair warns that the heating curve is unsafe for the floor.
data_description.base_temp: Coldest outdoor temperature the installation is designed for (about -15 °C in la ville).
data_description.weather_entity: Used by the heating curve simulator.

command_failed.message: The boiler did not accept the command: {message}

nothing_to_undo.message: No command can be undone (2 minutes at most, last command only).

set_override.name: Set temperature override
set_override.description: Changes the room setpoint for a duration.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Defaults to the duration chosen in the options.

set_holiday.name: Set holiday
set_holiday.description: Frost protection for whole days, from departure (0:00) to return day (0:00).

end.name: Return
end.description: Day of return: normal settings resume at 0:00.

set_week_program.name: Set week program
set_week_program.description: Replaces all switch points of a heating program (1 to 3) or of hot water. At most 6 per day.

program.name: Program
program.description: Heating program 1 to 3, or hot water.

switch_points.name: Switch points
switch_points.description: List of switch points. Heating: day (0 = Sunday … 6), time ("HH:MM"), activity (1 to 5). Hot water: day, time, comfort (true/false).

undo_last_command.name: Undo last command
undo_last_command.description: Restores the previous setting, within 2 minutes of the last command.

cloud_unreachable.title: {name}: De Dietrich cloud unreachable
cloud_unreachable.description: No reading for more than 15 minutes. Last error: {error}. Home Assistant keeps retrying.

low_pressure.title: {name}: low water pressure ({pressure} bar)
low_pressure.description: Top up the heating circuit, cold, to 1.5–2 bar with the filling valve under the boiler. If the pressure drops again within days, have a leak looked for.

unsafe_floor_curve.title: {name}: heating curve unsafe for the floor heating
unsafe_floor_curve.description: With slope {slope} and base {base} °C, the flow reaches about {flow} °C at {base_temp} °C outside, above the {max_floor_flow} °C allowed for a floor heated directly by the boiler. Lower the curve (slope and base settings). The maximum flow temperature of the boiler ({max_flow} °C) cannot be changed from the cloud: have your installer lower it.
